subject: Chemistry
source_note: Extracted from official JEE Advanced 2026 syllabus PDF (same as 2025): https://jeeadv.ac.in/documents/jee-advanced-2026-syllabus.pdf

subtopics: Concept of atoms and molecules; Dalton's atomic theory
Mole concept; chemical formulae; balanced chemical equations
Stoichiometric calculations based on chemical equations

topics.chapter: States of Matter: Gases and Liquids
subtopics: Gas laws, ideal gas equation, kinetic theory of gases
Deviation from ideality, van der Waals equation
Critical temperature, Boyle temperature, liquefaction
Graham's law of effusion and diffusion
Bohr model of hydrogen-like atoms
Quantum numbers, orbitals, Aufbau, Pauli, Hund
Hydrogen-like spectra and comparison of He+, Li2+
Ionic and covalent bonding, VSEPR, hybridisation
Molecular orbital theory, bond order, magnetic behaviour
Molecular geometry and planarity
First law: work, heat, internal energy, enthalpy
Second law: entropy, Gibbs energy, spontaneity
Reversible cycles and state functions
Law of mass action, Kc, Kp, Le Chatelier's principle
Ionic equilibrium: Ka, Kb, pH, buffer solutions
Solubility product and common-ion effect
Galvanic and electrolytic cells, Nernst equation
Standard electrode potentials, Kc from E°cell
Conductance, molar conductivity, Kohlrausch's law
Electrolysis and Faraday's laws
Rate law, order, molecularity, half-life
First-order and parallel reactions
Arrhenius equation and activation energy
Unit cells: sc, bcc, fcc; packing and density
Point defects including Schottky and Frenkel
Raoult's law and deviations from ideality
Colligative properties and van't Hoff factor
Adsorption: physisorption and chemisorption
Langmuir adsorption isotherm

topics.chapter: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
subtopics: Modern periodic table and electronic configurations
Periodic trends: radius, ionisation enthalpy, electronegativity
Position of hydrogen, isotopes, hydrides
Group 1 and Group 2 elements: properties and compounds
Groups 13 to 18: oxides, hydrides, oxoacids, interhalogens
Boron compounds including diborane and borazine
Transition elements: variable oxidation states, catalytic behaviour
Lanthanoids and actinoids: oxidation states and contraction
Werner's theory, IUPAC names, isomerism, optical activity
VBT and CFT, CFSE, magnetic moment
Principles of extraction: leaching, cyanide process, Hall–Héroult
Detection of common cations and anions
Characteristic tests used in inorganic and organic analysis
Hybridisation, inductive/resonance/hyperconjugation effects
Isomerism including optical and geometrical isomerism
Reactive intermediates: carbocations, carbanions, free radicals
Preparation, properties and reactions of alkanes
Physical properties of isomeric alkanes
Preparation, addition reactions, ozonolysis
Hydration of alkynes and tautomerism
Aromaticity and electrophilic aromatic substitution
Preparation, acidity and characteristic reactions of phenols
SN1, SN2 and elimination reactions of alkyl halides
Preparation, properties and reactions of alcohols
Preparation and reactions of ethers
Nucleophilic addition, aldol, Cannizzaro, iodoform, Tollens/Fehling
Preparation, acidity and reactions of carboxylic acids
Basicity of amines, electrophilic substitution of aniline
Nucleophilic aromatic substitution of haloarenes
Carbohydrates, amino acids, peptides and nucleic acids
Addition and condensation polymers; important commercial polymers
Drugs, detergents and important everyday chemicals
Detection of elements and functional groups; organic analysis
